scenicChapters.title: Şile Black Sea Coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Şile Black Sea Coast, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

sile-black-sea-coast.story: A one-way ride of 88 km, Şile to Kefken - roughly 1 h 42 in the saddle. On the way it passes Akçakoca side and Kandira. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
